channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🛡️ Bit Warden by Soliman
item.description: Watches your shared Grok Bot usage allowance and helps your other bots spend it efficiently, using only real numbers.
item.dc:creator: Soliman (@solimancf)

item.title: 🔌 Integrator · Setup & Sync by TheLobsterNest
item.description: Onboarding hub for newly imported Marketplace bots: connector setup, paused presets and conflict resolution in one place.
item.dc:creator: TheLobsterNest (@TheLobsterNest)

item.title: 🏈 Fantasy Recap by teslaFSD
item.description: Emails a fun, trash-talking weekly recap of your ESPN fantasy football league every Tuesday, with scores, standings and close games.
item.dc:creator: teslaFSD (@teslaFSD)

item.title: 🥷 Avatar Ninja by
item.description: Make a custom Grok Bot–style avatar in chat. They match the default bot styles exactly. Pick a look, get your picture, upload it under Set avatar. Free fan tool at ten.thousand.ninja. Not affiliated with xAI, SpaceXAI, or Cursor.

item.title: 📉 MY-QUANT by JeebsTX
item.description: Drop any cashtag and get an institutional-style quant grid: options GEX, expected move, volume profile, technicals, Fibonacci, short interest and a trade-structure idea. Research only, not financial advice.
item.dc:creator: JeebsTX (@JeebsTX)

item.title: 🎯 Act Before Noon by Cam Slater
item.description: Turns what you're facing into a few written, dated goals and one step to do before noon. Built on Cam Slater's goal-setting plan, with optional morning check-ins and faith only if you want it.
item.dc:creator: Cam Slater (@kaiviti_cam)

item.title: 🧾 File GST India by
item.description: Files Indian GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, nil returns) for small businesses and marketplace sellers on Amazon, Flipkart and Meesho, and prepares challans for you to pay.

item.title: 🍎 Apple Deal Price Slicer by Kent Weber
item.description: Finds the lowest real price on the Mac, iPhone, or iPad you want, whether new, refurbished, open-box, or used. Works from a model name or pasted link. Never buys without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Kent Weber (@KentBWeber)

item.title: 🔖 Bookmark Librarian by Jonathan Newburg
item.description: Organizes anyone’s X bookmarks into topic folders. Scans everything, proposes folders from post content (using any you already have), files after you approve, and can auto-sort new saves daily.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Newburg (@realjohnnewburg)

item.title: 📈 Rank · SEO Specialist by AdamDesigns
item.description: Gets your own website found in Google, Bing and AI search with a weekly Search Console review and one small page change at a time. Proposals only.
item.dc:creator: AdamDesigns (@Adamdesgns)

item.title: 🎵 Verse · AI Songwriter by AdamDesigns
item.description: Writes original songs for Suno: lyrics with section tags, plus a style prompt, built around the feeling you want.
item.dc:creator: AdamDesigns (@Adamdesgns)

item.title: 🧠 Psycho · Chief Mind Reader by AdamDesigns
item.description: A persuasion copywriter that turns what your product really does into posts, hooks and campaigns that make the right buyer think "that's my problem, I want this." It never invents proof.
item.dc:creator: AdamDesigns (@Adamdesgns)

item.title: 💻 Pulse · Gaming Laptop Tech by AdamDesigns
item.description: A Windows gaming-laptop tech: tells you why your PC is slow, hot, loud or weird, and gives ranked fixes. It never changes anything without your yes.
item.dc:creator: AdamDesigns (@Adamdesgns)

item.title: 🔍 Mason · The Incorporator by AdamDesigns
item.description: Drop in any link, tool, repo or post: it opens the original, checks the claims, separates hype from what the thing actually does, and gives a USE / TEST / WATCH / PASS verdict.
item.dc:creator: AdamDesigns (@Adamdesgns)

item.title: 🎚️ Doc Mastro by
item.description: Your audio engineer for Suno songs: measures your track and takes it from rough export to a loud, clean, release-ready master, with mix guidance, loudness QA and a release checklist. Paid ($19 founding price).

item.title: 📝 Davebot by Dave
item.description: A personal advocate that handles the tedious stuff: forms, complaints, records requests, emails, legal research and job leads, so you can focus on your life.
item.dc:creator: Dave (@dave04291978)

item.title: 🧠 SecondBrain by Justin
item.description: Front-door executive coordinator over all your bots. Maintains your Golden Registry of project rules, creates new divisions and projects so your registry and folders/repos never drift, and handles cross-division escalations.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: ☂️ Umbrella PM by Justin
item.description: Division-level PM that owns your division roster, shared documentation and handoff standards, and daily cross-project checks while coordinating the Project PMs under it.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: 📋 Project PM by Justin
item.description: Product and repo PM that plans with you, freezes approved Vision and Master Build Plans, writes zero-open-question handoffs pinned to branches and Draft PRs, verifies CI and diffs, and keeps an append-only Build Log.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: 💬 Slack-Ready: Team Bot by Justin
item.description: Turn any Grok Bot into a dedicated Slack teammate with its own Slack app manifest, masked bot token setup, auto-discovered channel IDs, and a loop-proof @-mention listener.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: 🛰️ Slack-Ready: Fleet Ops by Justin
item.description: Daily fleet health manager and weekly feature auditor for all of your Grok Bots. Runs a morning check-in across your bots, a weekly recent-changes capability audit, and an evening cutover journal—natively in Grok Bot chat or in Slack.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: 📬 Mail Bot by Justin
item.description: Personal email triage partner that tames overloaded Gmail, Outlook, Zoho, or AOL/Yahoo inboxes using a non-destructive staging-folder queue, VIP alerts, smart 2FA filtering, and draft-only reply safety—natively in Grok Bot chat or in Slack.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: 💵 Money Bot by Justin
item.description: Household finance manager with a 2-week payday cash-flow radar, Plaid + local ledger tracking, pre-due-date bill reminders, and a monthly subscription leak audit—natively in Grok Bot chat or in Slack.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@iamthejustin)

item.title: 📚 Harvard Classics: 15 Minutes a Day by John Bianchi
item.description: Read the Harvard Classics in fifteen minutes a day. A daily reading from Eliot's Five Foot Shelf with an excerpt, full-text link, reflection and questions, plus a dashboard to track your progress.
item.dc:creator: John Bianchi (@BTCJohnnyB)

item.title: 📖 Great Books: Reading Paths by John Bianchi
item.description: A great book, fifteen minutes a day. Pick a path (the Stoics, Shakespeare one act a day, Homer, Plato's dialogues, Dante one canto a day, or the Greek tragedies) and get a daily excerpt, full-text link, reflection and questions, with a dashboard for your streak and progress.
item.dc:creator: John Bianchi (@BTCJohnnyB)

item.title: 📊 Tally · ai by Matthew
item.description: A daily AI usage and cost report. It paces Grok Bot against a 14% daily budget, breaks down Cursor usage by model, and adds any other provider you use.
item.dc:creator: Matthew (@matthew_abbott_)

item.title: 🛡️ Zero-Day Desk by NeedMoreManas
item.description: A read-only zero-day analyst for security teams. Every weekday it turns CISA KEV, NVD, EPSS, OSV, GitHub advisories and vendor bulletins into a short, cited brief ranked for your stack, with alert cards and drafts you review before anything goes out.
item.dc:creator: NeedMoreManas (@NeedMoreManas)

item.title: 🧹 Clean Slate by
item.description: Helps you get your free credit reports, spot errors and outdated items, and draft FCRA dispute letters to all three bureaus.

item.title: 📵 Spam-Call Scrubber by
item.description: Finds your phone number on people-search and data-broker sites, submits the opt-outs, finishes the email confirmations, and re-checks on a schedule.

item.title: 🧾 Bills & Subscriptions Manager by J
item.description: Tracks your bills and subscriptions from a +bills email address on a monthly dashboard, and can pay bills through X Money once you approve.
item.dc:creator: J (@0xgramajo)

item.title: 🪪 RealityCheck by John
item.description: Scores an X handle for authenticity from public profile signals and makes a score card with green and red flags, as an estimate rather than a verdict.
item.dc:creator: John (@johnp_creates)

item.title: 🔎 ClaimCheck by John
item.description: Fact-checks viral X posts, headlines, and suspicious marketplace listings against primary sources, then makes a shareable verdict card.
item.dc:creator: John (@johnp_creates)

item.title: 🎁 Presents by Dylan
item.description: Plans holiday gifts with a list per person, prices from trusted stores, budgets, order-by dates, and price-drop alerts, and only buys when you say so.
item.dc:creator: Dylan (@dkmitc)

item.title: 📖 Exegesis by
item.description: Your Bible study companion. Ask about any passage, verse, or question and get what it says in context, with key Greek and Hebrew words, quoted from the KJV and WEB.

item.title: 🧾 Warranty & Returns Keeper by
item.description: Logs return deadlines and warranty end dates from your receipt emails and reminds you before each one runs out. Read-only on email.

item.title: 🎯 Critique by
item.description: Paste an X post, thread, screenshot, or your own idea and get a fast KILL or PURSUE with reasons. Every KILL comes with 1–3 ways to rescue the idea.

item.title: ⚖️ AI Legal Prep Desk by John
item.description: Helps small businesses and individuals research legal questions and prep contracts, compliance, and dispute documents.
item.dc:creator: John (@iamtheh0n3yp0t)

item.title: 🎙️ Stream Producer by beastnug
item.description: Keeps your stream schedule straight and drafts live titles, descriptions, go-live posts, and watch-party packs.
item.dc:creator: beastnug (@beastnug8)

item.title: 👗 Threads by Olive
item.description: Finds clothes and outfits that fit your size, style, and budget, with checked links and fit notes.
item.dc:creator: Olive (@CattoIs2Pure)

item.title: 📈 Perp Pulse by Yossi
item.description: Reads crypto perpetual futures funding, open interest, and liquidations across four exchanges and never places trades.
item.dc:creator: Yossi (@josephstayhappy)

item.title: 🎂 Birthday Bot by gooper
item.description: Tracks family birthdays and sends three budget-friendly gift ideas with links about 10 days before each one.
item.dc:creator: gooper (@gooper)

item.title: 🧾 FSA Receipt Keeper by SoCalFSD
item.description: Keeps your FSA or HSA receipts organized in a Google Sheet so you don't lose money at the claim deadline.
item.dc:creator: SoCalFSD

item.title: 📦 Address Mover by SoCalFSD
item.description: Moving? Finds every company in your Gmail with your address and preps each update with links or draft emails.
item.dc:creator: SoCalFSD

item.title: ♿ Accessibility Check by SoCalFSD
item.description: Scans a website you own for accessibility problems with axe and ranks what to fix first by impact.
item.dc:creator: SoCalFSD

item.title: ⚡ Outage Watch by SoCalFSD
item.description: Tells you only when an official weather alert or power outage hits your area; quiet otherwise.
item.dc:creator: SoCalFSD

item.title: 📚 Docs Keeper by SoCalFSD
item.description: Keeps your repo's README and CHANGELOG in step with what merged, via one draft pull request each week.
item.dc:creator: SoCalFSD

item.description: Audits your Grok Bot fleet for token waste, like chatty bots and too-frequent routines, and fixes the safe ones.
item.dc:creator: adrian

item.title: 🧰 Family Disaster Prep by Daniel

item.dc:creator: Daniel (@DB_DevilDog)
